notes: Water injection history of one well, two injection intervals (EP interval (Upper yellow), FP interval (Upper purple)) side by side; treated as one location. Page gives no place, county or state; 'lease OCS-P 0241' is the only other identifier. Data type unclear under the rules: water injected into a well (not a water-supply well), put as Other; Groundwater would be the alternative. No listed variable fits (water injected in bbls, well-head pressure) -> other. 24 monthly rows (June 1971 to May 1973: 7+12+5). Measurements counted = monthly water injected (24x2) + well-head pressure (24x2) = 96, zeros counted. Days of injection, cumulative and daily average (24x2 each = 144) treated as other/computed numbers: n_variables = 240.
